by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C
  have h : midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ midpoint ℝ A C = (⅟2 : ℝ) • (B -ᵥ C) :=
    midpoint_vsub_midpoint_same_left ℝ A B C
  constructor
  · rw [AffineSubspace.affineSpan_pair_parallel_iff_vectorSpan_eq, vectorSpan_pair, vectorSpan_pair, h]
    exact Submodule.span_singleton_smul_eq (IsUnit.mk0 _ (by norm_num)) _
  · rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V, dist_eq_norm_vsub V B C, h, norm_smul]
    norm_num
    ring
